identity.title: OLCC Recreational Marijuana Producer License (Tier II, Indoor), License No. 020-1004763A8B2

scan.summary: This is your state license from the OLCC that lets Evergreen Botanicals grow recreational marijuana at 2210 Bailey Hill Road. You have to renew it every year. This term runs from March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027 (page 1). It is the agency's document, so there is nothing in it for you to fix. What matters is getting the renewal in by February 10, 2027 and keeping records that show you meet its five conditions.
scan.freshness_note: This copy is for the current term, issued March 3, 2026, so you don't need a newer one right now. Once the renewal is approved (the next term would start around March 3, 2027), ask for the new license and file it in place of this one. The signature line on this copy is blank, which may just mean it's a printout. Keep the signed or official copy on display at the premises.

conditions.title: The license covers only 2210 Bailey Hill Road and cannot be transferred to another location or person
conditions.evidence_expected: The licensed premises diagram on file with the OLCC matches how the site is actually laid out, and no marijuana activity happens anywhere else

conditions.title: Renew every year: the renewal application and fee must reach the OLCC at least 20 days before the license expires
conditions.evidence_expected: Submission confirmation from the OLCC's online licensing system (CAMP) and a fee receipt dated on or before February 10, 2027

conditions.title: Track every marijuana item in the Cannabis Tracking System, and make sure every employee who handles marijuana holds a current OLCC marijuana worker permit
conditions.evidence_expected: CTS (Metrc) reconciliation and inventory records; a roster of employees handling marijuana, with each worker permit number and its expiry date

conditions.title: Keep video surveillance that meets OAR 845-025-1450, and keep recordings for at least 90 days
conditions.evidence_expected: A camera coverage map, a check showing at least 90 days of footage is kept, and system maintenance and outage logs

conditions.title: Tell the OLCC before any change in ownership, in the premises, or in who holds a financial interest takes effect
conditions.evidence_expected: Copies of change requests filed with the OLCC and its approvals, and an up-to-date list of everyone with a financial interest

conditions.title: Display the license at the premises where the public can see it
conditions.evidence_expected: The license posted where it can be seen at the Bailey Hill premises (a photo on file works as proof)

deadlines.title: Get the renewal application and fee to the OLCC (at least 20 days before expiry)
deadlines.source_line: A renewal application and the renewal fee must be received by the Commission no later than 20 days before the expiration date.

facts.affects: Needed for renewals, CTS (Metrc) account work, change requests, and worker permit links

facts.quote: License type: Producer — Tier II, Indoor
facts.affects: Sets the fee tier and the indoor production rules, including lighting and canopy limits

facts.quote: Canopy limit: 10,000 square feet mature plant canopy
facts.affects: Growing more mature canopy than this would break the license terms; any expansion needs OLCC approval

facts.quote: Licensed premises: 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, Oregon 97405
facts.affects: Marijuana activity is allowed only at this address; moving or expanding needs OLCC approval
Shows the license has been held since 2022, with a March anniversary each year

expected_missing.basis: similar companies, not a checked requirement

expected_missing.why: Cannabis growers that use pesticides are usually subject to Oregon Department of Agriculture and Oregon OSHA agricultural rules
expected_missing.basis: similar companies, not a checked requirement

OREGON LIQUOR AND CANNABIS COMMISSION
9079 SE McLoughlin Blvd, Portland, Oregon 97222
RECREATIONAL MARIJUANA PRODUCER LICENSE
License number: 020-1004763A8B2
Licensee: Evergreen Botanicals, LLC
Trade name: Evergreen Botanicals
Licensed premises: 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, Oregon 97405
License type: Producer — Tier II, Indoor
Canopy limit: 10,000 square feet mature plant canopy
Original issue date: March 3, 2022
Current term: March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027
Expiration date: March 2, 2027
This license is issued under ORS 475C and the rules of the Commission in OAR chapter 845, division 25, and
authorizes the licensee to produce marijuana at the licensed premises named above, subject to those rules and to the
conditions below.
Conditions of this license:
1. The license is valid only for the premises named above and is not transferable to any other location or person.
2. The license must be renewed annually. A renewal application and the renewal fee must be received by the
Commission no later than 20 days before the expiration date. A licensee that has submitted a complete renewal
application before that date may continue to operate until the Commission acts on it.
3. All marijuana items at the premises must be tracked in the Cannabis Tracking System, and every employee who
handles marijuana items must hold a current marijuana worker permit issued by the Commission.
4. Video surveillance meeting OAR 845-025-1450 must be maintained at the premises and recordings kept for at
least 90 days.
5. Any change in ownership, in the premises, or in the persons with a financial interest in the licensee must be
reported to the Commission before it takes effect.
This license must be displayed at the licensed premises where it can be seen by the public.
Issued by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission
Date of issue for the current term: March 3, 2026
Authorized signature: ____________________ Licensing Director
